policies.name: Mandatory Caloric Rationing
policies.description: Reduces daily intake to a gruel of algae paste and irradiated condensation. It ensures the shelter outlasts a siege, though the agonizing hunger breeds quiet resentment in the lower decks.

policies.name: Sanctuary Open-Gate Protocol
policies.description: Unseals the blast doors to the desperate throngs outside. It floods our corridors with cheap, willing hands, but brings the terrifying threat of surface contagions and strained life-support filters.

policies.name: Penal Labor & Coercion Mandate
policies.description: Condemns prisoners and captured hostiles to the deep geothermal vents and irradiated slag heaps. A brutal, necessary evil that spares our citizens from the lethal radiation down below.

policies.name: Narcotics Control & Prohibition
policies.description: Criminalizes the possession of neuro-stims and synthetic opiate analogues. It aims to sober a terrified populace, driving the lucrative black market deeper into the bunker's shadows and filling the brig with addicts.

policies.name: Universal Colonist Conscription
policies.description: Thrusts rusted Meridian Compact rifles into the hands of mechanics, botanists, and terrified teenagers. Survival demands everyone bleeds for the barricades, regardless of their fear or lack of training.

policies.name: Emergency Martial Law Decree
policies.description: Silences the civilian councils under the deafening crack of military boot steps. Absolute authority is transferred to the Security Directors, trading the illusion of freedom for cold, unyielding survival.
